title: GuardAgent: A General Guardrail Agent for LLM Agents

defines.name: GuardAgent
defines.definition: An LLM-based guardrail agent that checks whether target LLM agents' actions satisfy user-specified safety guard requests by generating and executing guardrail code.

problem: Existing LLM guardrails focus on textual input-output moderation and cannot reliably enforce diverse, action-level safety and access-control requests for LLM agents.
